experiment.name: demo-resnet50-50train-10test
experiment.title: Small-sample ResNet-50 demonstration: 50 training images, 10 held-out test images
experiment.purpose: A small, fully reproducible companion experiment to the main pipeline. It reuses the repository's ResNet-50 builder, preprocessing and metrics, and reports only metrics computed from real predictions on a 10-image held-out test set.

model.preprocessing: repo default: aspect-ratio-preserving resize-and-pad to 224x224, then ImageNet mean/std normalisation (colab/colab_helpers._resize_and_pad + src.data.normalize). No crop.

training.class_weights: inverse-frequency, computed from the fit rows only
training.batchnorm: kept in eval mode while fine-tuning: with 41 fit images per epoch the batch statistics are far too noisy to overwrite ImageNet statistics
training.selection_rule: best validation macro-F1, ties broken by lower validation loss; validation images are carved out of the 50 training images and never come from the test set

sampling.method: class-aware, per-class, without replacement, seeded and stratified. Test images are drawn first, then the validation carve-out, then the fit set, all from the same deduplicated class pools.

1. No DR signs.provenance: verbatim: the archive's no-DR-signs folder. 'No apparent DR' means no DR is visible according to the source label; it does not mean clinically healthy.

2. Mild (or early) NPDR.provenance: verbatim: the archive's mild (or early) NPDR folder. 'or early' is the archive's own wording; no re-grading is applied.

3. Moderate NPDR.provenance: verbatim: the archive's moderate NPDR folder.

4. Severe NPDR.provenance: verbatim: the archive's severe NPDR folder.

5. Very Severe NPDR.provenance: PROVISIONAL merge of Very Severe NPDR into Severe NPDR, exactly the same policy the repository already applies to the Mendeley folder '13. Very Severe NPDR' in config/config.yaml (label_mapping.mendeley). Recorded as a merge, not as a verbatim grade.

7. Advanced PDR.provenance: PROVISIONAL merge of Advanced PDR into PDR, exactly the same policy the repository already applies to the Mendeley folder '12. Advanced PDR' in config/config.yaml (label_mapping.mendeley). Recorded as a merge, not as a verbatim grade.

augmentation.source: applied by src.data.ClassifierDataset, driven by config/config.yaml (preprocessing.classification.augmentation) so the demo and the main pipeline share one implementation
transforms: horizontal flip (anatomically admissible for fundus laterality)
disabled_on_purpose: vertical flip (not anatomically neutral for fundus images)
random crop / centre crop (can remove border lesions)

resolved.batchnorm: kept in eval mode while fine-tuning: with 41 fit images per epoch the batch statistics are far too noisy to overwrite ImageNet statistics
